zh-TW.speaker: clark
zh-TW.text: 走啊吃宵夜！無敵蛋餅要加辣嗎？

zh-TW.speaker: billy
zh-TW.text: 我要加爆甜辣醬！再來一杯紅茶。

en.speaker: clark
en.text: Let's grab midnight snacks! Want chili on your egg pancake?

en.speaker: billy
en.text: Extra sweet chili sauce for me! And a classic iced black tea.

zh-TW.speaker: bohan
zh-TW.text: 傻師傅湯包一定要配一碗熱騰騰的排骨酥湯。

zh-TW.speaker: jerry
zh-TW.text: 懂吃喔！竹蒸籠剛掀開超香超燙的。

en.speaker: bohan
en.text: Sha Shi Fu soup dumplings must be paired with steaming hot crispy rib soup.

en.speaker: jerry
en.text: You know good food! Fresh out of the bamboo steamer, super aromatic.

zh-TW.speaker: happy
zh-TW.text: 那輛藍色小貨車餐車的炒泡麵真的香到犯規。

zh-TW.speaker: clark
zh-TW.text: 老闆說今天還有特調飲品，趕快去排隊！

en.speaker: happy
en.text: The fried instant noodles from the blue food truck smell insanely good.

en.speaker: clark
en.text: The chef said there's a signature drink today, let's queue up!
